svg.title: The Last Jackpot — implemented casino and hotel floor plan
svg.desc: Accurate two-dimensional plan of the new 60 by 32 metre starting casino, west bar, east cashier public room and inaccessible cash area, south High Roller, northwest supply, unchanged hotel lobby, upstairs restaurant and concealed luggage gallery. The Velvet Hour speakeasy connects to the cashier public room through a portrait puzzle. Forty-eight slot cabinets, two craps tables, two roulette tables, two existing flush tables and seven individually purchased doors are shown.
svg.text: A grander casino. The same Grand Hotel.
60 × 32 m starting casino · 48 slots · 7 paid doors
All rooms in their actual positions · elevation 0 m
Elevation +4 m · same scale and orientation
The restaurant sits above the rear lobby and concealed gallery.
Each door has its own purchase. Buying A does not open B;
buying C does not open D. Supply requires hotel access first.
GAME FLOOR / MATCHING YOUR COLOR KEY
1 flush in the casino + 1 in High Roller
P Pistol ammo S Shotgun M SMG R Pit Boss rifle
U Upgrade workshop ◆ Enemy entry - - Floor above
Teal barrier: intact cashier glass; actors and shots stop here.
Purple doors: hotel gallery key / Velvet Hour portrait puzzle.
Hatching: inaccessible cashier staff area reserved for later.
Furniture footprints are physical bounds, not mesh silhouettes.
CENTRAL GAMES OPEN FROM THE START
Slots, craps, roulette and the first flush table fill the shared starting hall.
Every surrounding room opens through progression. The cashier back area stays closed.
Shared casino layout · live hotel geometry · actual fixtures, purchases and spawns
Doors shown in their initial closed state. / 01
